name: off-bench-oblique-hold
instructions:
1. Setup in a staggered stance with your bottom leg forward and hook your feet underneath a secure bench.
2. Hold a plate at chest level and press horizontally to extension as you exhale.
3. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
